articles.title: Southeast Asia bloc meets to press Thailand, Cambodia on truce
articles.summary: Recent reignited clashes between Cambodia and Thailand have escalated, with Thai air strikes damaging a Cambodian bridge and displacing hundreds of thousands. In response, Southeast Asian foreign ministers met to address the conflict. This situation underscores the fragile peace in the region and the critical role of diplomatic efforts in resolving cross-border disputes and mitigating humanitarian crises.

articles.title: Can India really rival China’s navy?
articles.summary: In early May, India and Pakistan engaged in four days of rocket and missile exchanges. Amidst this confrontation, the 40,000-tonne Indian aircraft carrier, INS Vikrant, led a significant naval flotilla. This highlights India's maritime power projection capabilities and strategic readiness during regional tensions, crucial for SSB aspirants studying national security and defence strategy.
